blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cross-sensor remote sensing image retrieval aims to find scenes with the same content across heterogeneous sensors, such as SAR and optical or panchromatic (PAN) and multispectral (MS) imagery, without manual labels. Existing self-supervised methods either reconstruct sensor-specific pixel detail, align each image only with its co-registered twin, or rely on large transformers with 118-173M parameters (and up to 398M). We introduce RS-JEPA, a compact joint-embedding predictive framework built on a Vision Mamba encoder shared by both sensors. Since a state-space encoder reads an image as an ordered sequence of patches, we propose scan-path views, which treat two reading orders of the same image as two views with identical pixels and predict the hidden patches in one order from the visible patches in the other.To keep this prediction challenging, we propose Adversarial View Coupling (AVC), which learns the hardest split of the visible patches, and a neighbourhood consensus loss that aligns the scene similarities of both sensors. Extensive experiments on SAR-optical (BEN-14K, CBRSIR-VS) and PAN-MS (DSRSID) benchmarks demonstrate that RS-JEPA achieves the highest F1@5 among twelve re-implemented methods (72.92, 80.35 and 94.43) with a retrieval network of only 3.88M parameters (14.57M in training, 8-16times fewer than prior JEPA retrievers). Like prior methods, RS-JEPA trains on co-registered pairs. Our results highlight reading order as a source of self-supervised views. code: https://github.com/Tanishq251/RSJEPA.
blocks.zh: 跨传感器遥感图像检索的目的是在各种传感器中找到内容相同的场景,例如合成孔径雷达、光学或全色成像和多光谱成像,而无需人工标记。 现有的自控方法要么重建传感器特有像素细节,只将每个图像与其共同注册的双子对齐,要么依靠有118-173M参数(并可达398M)的大型变压器. 我们介绍RS-JEPA,这是一个紧凑的联合组合预测框架,以两个传感器共用的Vision Mamba编码器为基础。 由于一个状态-空间编码器读取一幅图像作为命令的补丁序列,所以我们提出扫描-路径视图,将两个相同图像的读取顺序作为两个像素相同的视图处理,并从另一个可见的补丁中以一个顺序预测隐藏的补丁. 为了保持这种预测具有挑战性,我们提出Aversarial View Coupling(AVC),它学习了可见补丁中最难分出的部分,以及邻里共识的丧失,使两种传感器的场景相近一致. 关于SAR-光学(BEN-14K、CBRSIR-VS)和PAN-MS(DSRSID)基准的广泛实验表明,RS-JEPA在12个重新实施的方法中实现了最高的F1@5(72.92、80.35和94.43),检索网络中只有3.88M参数(培训中的14.57M,比以前的JEPA检索器少了8至16次)。 与以前的方法一样,RS-JEPA以共同注册的配对进行训练. 我们的结果突出了阅读秩序作为自我监督观点的来源. 代码:https://github.com/Tanishq251/RSJEPA.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Accuracy against model size. Mean F1@5 over the three benchmarks against retrieval throughput (marker area: parameters).
blocks.zh: 图1:模型尺寸的精确度。 相对于检索吞吐量(标志区:参数)而言,平均F1@5。

blocks.en:
Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images the ground through cloud and at night, whereas optical sensors provide detailed multispectral or panchromatic images only under clear skies [ 23 , 6 , 14 ] . Cross-sensor image retrieval ranks the images of one sensor by their content similarity to a query from another [ 20 ] .
This is difficult because the same scene looks very different across sensors, labels are scarce at archive scale, and every archive image must be embedded, which favours small encoders.
Masked image models [ 12 , 5 , 16 ] reconstruct pixels and thus also learn sensor noise such as SAR speckle.
Cross-sensor alignment models [ 8 , 28 ] match each image with its co-registered counterpart but ignore how different scenes relate.
Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) [ 1 ] predict features instead of pixels, and X-JEPA [ 4 ] and CR-JEPA [ 13 ] lead label-free retrieval on BEN-14K this way, but rely on large transformers that are costly to run over whole archives.
State-space models (SSMs) [ 9 , 31 ] are far smaller, yet they read an image as an ordered sequence, while existing self-supervised views were designed for order-agnostic attention.
blocks.zh:
合成孔径雷达通过云和夜间图像地面,而光学传感器只在晴天下提供详细的多光谱或全色图像[23、6、14]。 跨传感器图像检索按其内容与另一个传感器查询的相似性对一个传感器的图像进行排序[20].
这很困难,因为同一场景在传感器之间看起来非常不同,在归档尺度上标签很少,每个归档图像都必须嵌入,这有利于小编码器.
蒙面图像模型 [12, 5, 16] 重建像素,从而也学习SAR Speekle等传感器噪声.
交叉传感器对齐模型[8,28]将每个图像与共同注册的对应对象匹配,但忽略了不同场景之间的关联.
联合嵌入式预测架构(JEPAs)[1] 预测特征而不是像素,以及X-JEPA[4]和CR-JEPA[13] 这样在BEN-14K上进行无标铅检索,但依靠大变压器,运行整个档案成本高昂.
国家空间模型(SSM)[9,31]要小得多,但是它们读出一个图像作为命令序列,而现有的自我监督的视图则是为了命令不可知的注意而设计的.

blocks.en: Can we design a compact cross-sensor retrieval model that learns what a scene contains, regardless of the sensor, simply by reading it in two different orders?
blocks.zh: 我们能否设计一个紧凑的跨传感器检索模型,来了解一个场景包含什么,不管传感器是什么,只要用两个不同的顺序来读它就可以了?

blocks.en:
A selective SSM summarises only the tokens it has already read, so its output for a patch depends on how the patch grid is flattened [ 9 , 31 ] .
Two traversals of one image therefore give two feature sequences from identical pixels, which is a natural pair of views.
Only scene content stays predictable across paths; speckle and other sensor texture do not.
Since prediction happens in feature space and the views come from the encoder itself, no image editing or momentum encoder is needed.
blocks.zh:
选择性的SSM只概括它已经读取的符号,因此它对于补丁的输出取决于补丁网格是如何被平整的[9,31].
因此,一个图像的两段曲面给出了来自相同像素的两个特征序列,这是天然的对视图.
只有场景内容保持跨路径的可预见性;Speckle和其他传感器纹理没有.
由于预测发生在特征空间,而视图来自编码器本身,因此不需要图像编辑或动力编码器.

blocks.en:
Existing vision SSMs fix the traversal or combine several directions [ 15 , 18 ] , discarding reading order before it can supervise learning.
Self-supervised remote sensing methods build views by masking, augmentation or sensor pairing [ 1 , 8 , 28 ] , assuming order-insensitive encoders.
To our knowledge, no prior work has shown whether reading order can generate views for cross-sensor joint-embedding prediction, or how to train such views for retrieval.
blocks.zh:
现存的视觉SSM修饰曲面或结合多个方向[15,18],在监督学习之前抛弃读取顺序.
自行监督的遥感方法通过遮盖,扩增或传感器配对[1,8,28]来构筑视图,假设不敏感的编码器.
据我们所知,没有前期工作显示阅读顺序是否能够为交叉传感器联合嵌入式预测产生视图,或者如何培训这些视图进行检索。

blocks.en: Two complementary challenges must be addressed together. First , two scan paths over the same visible patches share much local context, so the predictor can exploit spatial continuity instead of modelling the scene, making the task too easy. Second , instance-level contrastive alignment pulls each scene towards its twin but leaves other scenes unconstrained, so the two sensors may induce different neighbourhoods, which directly harms retrieval.
blocks.zh: 必须共同应对两个相辅相成的挑战。 首先,在同一可见补丁上的两条扫描路径共享许多局部上下文,因此预测器可以利用空间连续性而不是模拟场景,使得任务过于简单. 第二,实例级对比对齐将每个场景拉向它的双胞胎,但让其他场景不受限制,因此这两个传感器可能诱发不同的邻里,直接伤害检索.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce RS-JEPA, a remote sensing JEPA that learns cross-sensor features from the reading order of one Vision Mamba encoder shared by both sensors.
Its scan-path views encode the visible patches along one traversal and predict the stop-gradient features of the hidden patches along another.
For the first challenge, Adversarial View Coupling (AVC) learns, through gradient reversal, the split of visible patches that is hardest to predict and couples the two halves with cross-view attention.
For the second, a neighbourhood consensus loss aligns the same- and cross-sensor similarity distributions of both sensors.
RS-JEPA achieves the highest mean F1@5 among twelve re-implemented methods on three benchmarks with a retrieval network of only 3.88M parameters.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们介绍了RS-JEPA,这是一种遥感JEPA,从两个传感器共用的一台Vision Mamba编码器的读取顺序中学习跨传感器特征。
它的扫描-路径视图将可见的补丁沿着一个横贯的路段编码,并预测隐藏的补丁沿着另一个路段的止步特性.
对于第一个挑战,Aversarial View Coupling(AVC)通过梯度反转,学习到难以预测的可见补丁的分割,以及用交叉视图关注来对准两半.
第二,邻里共识的丧失与两个传感器的相同和跨传感器相似的分布一致。
RS-JEPA在三个基准上的十二个重实施方法中实现了最高的平均值F1@5,检索网络只有3.88M参数.

blocks.en: Our key contributions are as follows: • We propose RS-JEPA , a compact joint-embedding predictive framework for label-free cross-sensor retrieval with one shared Vision Mamba encoder. • We introduce scan-path views , which predict the hidden patches in one order from the visible patches in another, without image editing or a momentum encoder. • We design Adversarial View Coupling (AVC), which learns the hardest split of the visible patches into two views, and a teacher-free neighbourhood consensus loss that aligns the scene similarities of both sensors. • Extensive experiments on BEN-14K, CBRSIR-VS and DSRSID demonstrate state-of-the-art retrieval performance with a substantially smaller model.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提议RS-JEPA,一个紧凑的联合组合预测框架,用于无标签跨传感器检索,并配有一个共用的Vision Mamba编码器。 我们引入扫描路径视图, 它从另一个可见的补丁中以一个顺序预测隐藏的补丁, 没有图像编辑或动力编码器 。 我们设计了Adversari View Coupling(AVC),它学习了将可见的补丁最难分解为两个视图,以及一个无教师的邻里共识的丧失,使两个传感器的场景相似度一致. • 关于BEN-14K、CBRSIR-VS和DSRSID的大量实验,用一个小得多的模型展示了最先进的检索性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Self-Supervised Learning in Remote Sensing: Masked image modelling [ 12 ] has been adapted to satellite imagery with spectral and temporal grouping [ 5 ] , multiple scales [ 16 , 17 , 22 ] and rotated windows [ 26 ] .
For radar–optical pairs, CROMA [ 8 ] combines redrawing with cross-sensor matching, DeCUR [ 28 ] separates shared from sensor-specific features, and others use self-distillation [ 29 ] or fusion [ 2 ] ; SkySense [ 10 ] and RoMA [ 27 ] scale this to foundation models.
They target fine-tuning for classification or segmentation, not small retrieval encoders.
blocks.zh:
自我监督 遥感学习:蒙面图像建模[12]已根据卫星图像进行调整,采用光谱和时间分组[5]、多尺度[16、17、22]和旋转窗口[26]。
对于雷达-光学对子,CROMA [8] 结合重绘与跨传感器匹配,DeCUR [28] 分离与传感器特定特性共享,其他则使用自沉[29]或聚变[2];SkySense [10]和RoMA [27] 将这个比例缩放到基础模型.
它们针对分类或分区的微调,而不是小的检索编码器.

blocks.en:
Cross-Sensor Retrieval: Early methods learned binary hash codes for radar and optical images from labels [ 30 , 21 ] on paired benchmarks such as BigEarthNet-MM [ 19 , 20 ] .
CSMAE [ 11 ] removed the labels with cross-sensor masked autoencoders, and X-JEPA [ 4 ] and CR-JEPA [ 13 ] replaced pixel redrawing with cross-sensor feature prediction in large transformers; RS-JEPA uses a compact state-space encoder. While REJEPA [ 3 ] predicts masked patch embeddings within a single image for same-sensor retrieval, RS-JEPA uses adversarially split scan views and symmetric neighbourhood consensus to align scene similarities across radar and optical embeddings.
blocks.zh:
交叉传感器 检索 : 早期的方法从BigEarthNet-MM[19,20]等成对基准的标签[30,21]上学习到雷达和光学图像的二元散列编码.
CSMAE [11] 移除了带有跨传感器遮盖自动编码器的标签,X-JEPA [4] 和CR-JEPA [13] 在大型变压器中以跨传感器特性预测取代像素重绘;RS-JEPA使用紧凑的状态空间编码器. 虽然REJEPA[3]预测在单一图像中嵌入遮盖的补丁供同传感器检索,但RS-JEPA使用对抗性的分割扫描视图和对称的邻里共识来调和雷达和光学嵌入的场景相似性.

blocks.en: Views and Relations in Self-Supervised Learning: Rather than relying on heuristic image augmentations or asymmetric teacher-student models [ 1 , 7 ] , RS-JEPA couples adversarial view splitting (AVC) with symmetric neighbourhood consensus to align cross-sensor similarity geometry without external guidance.
blocks.zh: 在自我监督的学习中的观点和关系: RS-JEPA夫妇的对抗性观点分裂(AVC)与对称的邻里共识,不依靠高压图像增强或不对称的师生模式[1,7],而是在没有外部指导的情况下将交叉感官相似几何对齐.

blocks.en:
State-Space Models for Vision: Vision Mamba (Vim) [ 31 ] adapts selective state-space models [ 9 ] to vision by traversing patch sequences bidirectionally, while VMamba [ 15 ] incorporates four-way scanning directions, and autoregressive models [ 18 ] enforce sequential ordering.
In prior works, the scan trajectory is treated as a fixed architectural choice; RS-JEPA instead leverages multi-directional scan paths as an intrinsic source of multi-view self-supervision.
blocks.zh:
视觉的状态-空间模型:Vision Mamba(Vim)[31]通过双向翻转补丁序列使选择性的状态-空间模型[9]适应视觉,而VMamba[15]则包含四向扫描方向,自转模型[18]执行顺序排序.
在之前的作品中,扫描轨迹被视作固定的建筑选择;而RS-JEPA则利用多方向扫描路径作为多视图自超视觉的内在来源.

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present RS-JEPA, which learns cross-sensor retrieval features without labels by predicting the features of hidden patches, rather than their pixels, with a single Vision Mamba encoder shared by both sensors.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍RS-JEPA,它通过预测隐藏补丁的特性而不是其像素来学习没有标签的跨传感器检索特性,同时使用两个传感器共用的单一Vision Mamba编码器.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Data Splits
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和数据分割

blocks.en:
We use three dual-sensor benchmarks; training is label-free and train and test scenes do not overlap. BEN-14K [ 19 ] , a BigEarthNet subset over ten European countries, has 14,832 Sentinel-1 (VV/VH, S1) and Sentinel-2 (12 bands, S2) pairs with 19 CORINE land-cover multi-labels; 11,310 train / 3,522 test. CBRSIR-VS [ 21 ] pairs SAR (S1) and RGB (S2) views of the same scene, which differ strongly in appearance: 26,901 pairs, 10 classes, per-class 70/30 split (18,831 / 8,070). DSRSID [ 14 ] pairs Gaofen-1 high-resolution panchromatic (S1) and lower-resolution 4-band multispectral (S2) images: 80,000 pairs, 8 classes, per-class 70/30 split (56,000 / 24,000).
All images are resized to 120 × 120 120\times 120 and normalised per channel; every test sample is both query and gallery item.
blocks.zh:
我们使用三个双重传感器基准;培训是无标签的,火车和试验场景没有重叠。 BEN-14K [19],是大地球网的子集,分布于10个欧洲国家,拥有14,832个哨兵1(VV/VH,S1)和哨兵2(12个带,S2)对,配有19个CORINE土地覆盖多标签;11,310列列车 / 3,522次测试. CBRSIR-VS [21]对同场景SAR(S1)和RGB(S2)的视差很大,外观差异很大:26,901对,10类,每类70/30分(18,831/8,070),DSRSID [14]对Gaofen-1高分辨率全色(S1)和下分辨率4波段多光谱(S2)图像:80,000对,8类,每类70/30分(56,000/24000).
所有图像的大小调整为120×120 120\时,每个通道正常化;每个测试样本都是查询和画廊项目.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: RS-JEPA uses a 12-block Vim encoder (width 192) on 10 × 10 10\times 10 patches, a fixed 60% masking ratio [ 1 , 4 ] , a six-layer predictor and four CVA blocks, with τ = 0.07 \tau=0.07 , τ r = 0.1 \tau_{r}=0.1 and λ rel = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{rel}}=1 . We train for 100 epochs with AdamW (batch 290, learning rate warmed up to 10 − 3 10^{-3} over 15 epochs, then cosine decay) and identical random flips and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} rotations on both sensors, and report results across independent runs. All experiments run in PyTorch on four NVIDIA V100 GPUs with 32 GB RAM and an Intel Xeon CPU.

blocks.en: Baselines: DeCUR uses a ResNet-50 backbone, as in its original design [ 28 ] , and the other seven use a ViT-Base/16 backbone; all eight are re-implemented following the X-JEPA protocol [ 4 ] and trained from scratch by us for 100 epochs on the same pairs at 120 × 120 120\times 120 , with shared retrieval code; single-sensor MAE variants get one encoder per sensor and an InfoNCE head. Fig. 5 thus compares methods under one training budget, not their best published results ( e.g . , CR-JEPA reports 75.82/75.40 cross-sensor F1@5 on BEN-14K after 400 epochs at 224 × 224 224\times 224 [ 13 ] ); at their original 224 × 224 224\times 224 setting, X-JEPA and CR-JEPA still trail RS-JEPA ( Fig. 6 c).

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价议定书

blocks.en:
Following X-JEPA [ 4 ] , we evaluate four retrieval directions (S1 → \to S1, S2 → \to S2, S1 → \to S2, S2 → \to S1) and their mean. The main metric is F1@5 between the label sets of the query and its top-5 results, which equals precision@5 on the single-label CBRSIR-VS and DSRSID.
For mAP, a result is relevant if it shares a label with the query.
Same-sensor search excludes the query, while the cross-sensor gallery keeps its co-registered partner [ 4 , 13 ] ; Sec. 5 also reports results without it.
blocks.zh:
继X-JEPA[4]之后,我们评价四个检索方向(S1 →\to S1,S2 →\to S2,S1 →\to S2,S2 →\to S1)及其平均值. 主要衡量标准是查询的标签集与其上5个结果之间的F1@5,这等于单标签CBRSIR-VS和DSRSID上的精度@5.
对于mAP,如果结果与查询共享标签,则结果相关.
同感器搜索排除了查询,而跨感器画廊则保持其共同注册的合作伙伴[4,13];第5sec也报告结果没有它.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 5 , RS-JEPA achieves the best F1@5 in every direction on all three benchmarks, improving the mean over the strongest baseline by 3.11 points on BEN-14K (CR-JEPA), 2.28 on CBRSIR-VS (DeCUR) and 5.99 on DSRSID (SkySense).
The baselines rank inconsistently across datasets: DeCUR, for instance, leads on CBRSIR-VS but is among the weakest on DSRSID. RS-JEPA ranks first throughout.
Its advantage is consistently larger in cross-sensor than in same-sensor retrieval, in line with an objective that targets content shared by both sensors.
When each query’s co-registered partner is removed from the cross-sensor gallery, RS-JEPA still leads on all benchmarks (70.46, 78.82 and 93.55 vs . 67.82, 75.07 and 85.81 for the strongest baselines), so its margin does not rely on instance matching.
Over the depths in Tab. 4 , RS-JEPA is best in 59 of the 60 direction and average columns, the exception being S2 → \to S2 F1@20 on CBRSIR-VS, where DeCUR leads by 0.29 points. On DSRSID, its lead in average F1 widens from 2.88 points at k = 1 k=1 to 7.36 at k = 20 k=20 , showing that its ranking stays reliable deeper into the retrieved list.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,RS-JEPA在所有三个基准上每个方向都取得了最好的F1@5,使BEN-14K(CR-JEPA)的平均值超过最强基线3.11点,CBRSIR-VS(DECUR)的2.28点和DSRSID(SkySense)的5.99点。
各种数据集的基线排名不一致:例如,DECUR在CBRSIR-VS上领先,但在DSRSID上属于最弱者之列。 RS-JEPA在全局排名第一.
其优势在跨传感器方面一直大于同一传感器检索方面,这符合针对两个传感器共有内容的目标。
当每个查询的共同注册伙伴从交叉传感器旁听席上移除时,RS-JEPA仍然领先于所有基准(70.46,78.82和93.55对67.82,75.07和85.81对最强基线),因此其比值并不依赖于实例匹配.
过塔布深处. 4,RS-JEPA在60个方向和平均列中的59个位置最好,例外是CBRSIR-VS上的S2 →\to S2 F1@20,其中DECUR领先0.29分. 在DSRSID上,其平均F1的领先点从 k = 1 k = 1 到 7.36 k = 20 k = 20 ,显示其排名在检索列表中仍然可靠.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows the top-5 results for one query per direction and benchmark, selected by a fixed rule rather than by hand.
Over the two queries per benchmark, RS-JEPA retrieves at least as many relevant scenes as every other method, and all ten of its results on DSRSID match the query class.
A few queries cannot by themselves support general conclusions.

RS-JEPA uses 14.57M parameters during training, of which only 3.88M are retained for retrieval, since the AVC modules, predictors and target pass serve training alone.
Embedding one S1–S2 pair requires 2.23 GFLOPs, against 230.47M parameters and 32.98 GFLOPs for X-JEPA ( Fig. 5 ), corresponding to roughly 16 × \times fewer parameters and 15 × \times fewer operations. We also timed every model of Fig. 5 on one V100 with FP16. At batch size 64, RS-JEPA embeds 1,918 pairs per second, faster than all baselines except DeCUR (3,235), and needs the least GPU memory at batch 256 (0.60 GiB against 1.34–3.90 GiB).
For a single pair, however, it takes 33.1 ms against 13.7–21.1 ms for most baselines, as its many small scan kernels leave the GPU idle, so its advantage lies in batched embedding.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We proposed RS-JEPA, a compact JEPA for label-free cross-sensor retrieval that turns the reading order of a shared Vision Mamba encoder into scan-path views, makes their prediction harder with Adversarial View Coupling, and aligns the sensors through neighbourhood consensus. With a 3.88M-parameter retrieval network, RS-JEPA achieves the highest F1@5 of twelve re-implemented methods across all three benchmarks, while CROMA remains ahead in full-ranking mAP on BEN-14K. Limitations. RS-JEPA still needs co-registered training pairs, limiting scale. We test three benchmarks at 120 × 120 120\times 120 pixels, with no unseen regions or other sensors, one fixed scan-path set and a shared baseline budget. Ablations are scored on the test splits, so they show trends only. Training adds 10.7M parameters; its time cost is unmeasured. Broader archives and transfer to new regions are future work. Reading order is thus an effective source of self-supervised views.
blocks.zh: 我们提出RS-JEPA, 即JEPA, 用于无标签跨传感器检索, 通过3.88M参数检索网络,RS-JEPA在所有三个基准中实现12个重新执行方法中最高的F1@5,而CROMA在BEN-14K上仍然领先于全方位的mAP. 限制。 RS-JEPA仍然需要共同注册的训练配对,限制规模. 我们以120×120 120\时120像素测试三个基准,没有看不见的区域或其他传感器,一个固定扫描路径集和一个共享基线预算。 试射分数上得分,因此只显示趋势. 培训增加了10.7M参数;其时间成本没有计量。 扩大档案和向新区域转让是今后的工作。 因此阅读顺序是自我监督观点的有效来源.
